reviews.text: I’ve bought multiples of this because it’s been my most favorite oil cleanser, it has not let me down. My face texture has improved since I’ve started using it.
reviews.zh: 呢款我回購咗好多次，係我最鍾意嘅卸妝油，從來冇令我失望過。用咗之後，塊面嘅膚質改善咗。

reviews.text: Pretty gentle cleansing oil that doesn't break out my skin! I love the simple ingredient list, which is one of the reasons why I tried this in the first place. Not too fond of the smell, but that goes for most cleansing oils that I've tried. Will continue to repurchase!
reviews.zh: 卸妝油好溫和，用完冇爆瘡！我好鍾意佢成分表好簡潔，亦係我最初想試嘅原因之一。唔係好鍾意個味，不過大部分卸妝油都係咁。會繼續回購！

reviews.text: I wanted to love this but it broke me outㅠ_ㅠ. It did reduce my blackheads after I first washed my face with it, but after looking in the mirror again the blackheads all come back and it looks as if there are more blackheads on my nose!!! Im so sad that it didn’t work out for me.
reviews.zh: 我本來好想鍾意佢，但佢令我爆瘡ㅠ_ㅠ。用完第一次洗面後黑頭係有減少，但再睇鏡就發現黑頭全部返晒嚟，而且鼻上好似仲多咗！！！真係好難過呢款唔啱我。

reviews.text: Hesitant at first to use a cleansing oil as my skin is sensitive and prone to hormonal trouble / spot breakouts if my pores are overwhelmed, but this formula is so gentle and effective on taking off the most robust make up/SPF. I follow up with their mung bean cleansing too and it makes my skin feel so clean without tightness. Love there’s no scent. 10/10
reviews.zh: 一開始對用卸妝油有啲猶豫，因為我皮膚敏感，一旦毛孔負擔過重就會有荷爾蒙失調／局部爆瘡嘅問題，但呢款配方好溫和，對卸走最頑固嘅彩妝同防曬都好有效。我會再用佢哋嘅綠豆潔面產品一齊用，皮膚感覺好乾淨又唔會繃。最鍾意佢冇香味。10/10

reviews.text: This is my go-to cleaning oil, that cleans super well, doesn't have a strong scent, doesn't sting my eyes in the process, & works well on my sensitive skin. Been using for the past few years with no problem!
reviews.zh: 呢款係我嘅心水卸妝油，清潔力超強、冇乜香味、用嘅過程唔會刺眼，對我嘅敏感肌都好啱用。過去幾年都一直用緊，冇出現過任何問題！

reviews.text: IM TOTALLY OBSESSED is better than anua I just try it and unclogged a lot of sebum on my face more than the anua oil and is lightweight than the manyo oil I will marry this product it didnt irritate and leaves a clean and soothing sensation
reviews.zh: 我完全迷上咗呢款，勁過anua！我啱啱試咗，塊面清走咗勁多油脂，比anua嗰支更出色，而且比manyo嗰支更輕盈。我要同呢款產品結婚！佢冇引起刺激，仲有清爽同舒緩嘅感覺。

reviews.text: I've been using manyo oil cleanser for years and that made me break out the next day. It would also make my skin feel dry and itchy. But this one is definitely a game changer for me. So glad I decided to try this one out. Effective with removing black/whiteheads and makeup!
reviews.zh: 我用咗manyo卸妝油好多年，但用完第二日就會爆瘡，仲會令皮膚又乾又痕。但呢款對我嚟講絕對係game changer。好慶幸自己決定試咗呢款。去除黑白頭同彩妝都好有效！

reviews.text: lighter than manyo and the numbuzin cleansing oil. still leaves some residue so it takes a good minute of face rinsing to feel fully clean— i imagine that could be irritating for people with sensitive skin who want to minimize their routine. i usually use a cleansing foam to help rinse off the residue. i did find i need to use a separate makeup remover for heavier makeup.
reviews.zh: 比 manyo 同 numbuzin 嘅卸妝油清薄。不過都會留低少少殘留物，所以要沖水沖成一分鐘左右先覺得徹底乾淨——我諗對於想簡化護膚步驟嘅敏感肌嚟講可能會有啲刺激。我通常會用潔面泡沫幫手沖走殘留物。較厚重嘅妝容我發現要額外用卸妝產品先卸得乾淨。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
